Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the respondent.

2. This petition is filed by the wife seeking transfer of the matrimonial proceedings in M.C. No.33 of 2024, pending before the Senior Civil Judge and JMFC Court, Chittapur to the Principal Judge,
Family Court, Kalaburagi.

entities.text: Senior Civil Judge and JMFC Court, Chittapur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. It is the contention of the learned counsel that the petitioner is the legally wedded wife of the respondent and their marriage having taken place on 20.02.2022 at Parvati Kalyan Mantap, Laxmi Gunj, Shahabad, Taluk Shahabad, District Kalaburagi as per the Hindu customs, rites and ceremonies.

Due to certain differences, assault and harassment by the respondent/husband, the petitioner returned to her parental home and filed a NC: 2026:KHC-K:769 HC-KAR criminal complaint against the respondent and his family members before the Kalaburagi Women Police Station in Crime No.46/2023 for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 501, 149 of the Indian Penal Code read with Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

This being the state of affairs, the petitioner also filed a petition under Section 125 of Cr.P.C., in Criminal Miscellaneous No.515 of 2023 before the Principal Judge, Family Court at Kalaburagi which is pending adjudication and the respondent has accepted notice and is appearing in the matter.

entities.text: Principal Judge, Family Court at Kalaburagi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
It is further contended that the respondent/husband has initiated a petition for divorce under Section 13(I) (i-a)
of the Hindu Marriage Act in MC No.33/2024 against the petitioner before the Senior Civil Judge and JMFC Court, Chittapur.

entities.text: Senior Civil Judge and JMFC Court, Chittapur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. It is the contention of the learned counsel for the petitioner that the Court at Chittapur is at a distance of 55 kilometers from Kalaburagi.
It will take more than two hours for the petitioner to reach there.

The same will NC: 2026:KHC-K:769 HC-KAR be tedious and uncomfortable and hardship could be caused to the petitioner to travel, so also she contends that her parents are suffering from old age ailments including BP and diabetes and she is facing financial difficulties.

She Revathi vs Anand on 30 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109239511/
2 further contends that if the petition from the Senior Civil Judge and JMFC Court, Chittapur is transferred to the Principal Judge, Family Court at Kalaburagi, it would not cause hardship or inconvenience to the respondent/husband, as he is already attending the Court case initiated by the petitioner/wife before the Family Court, Kalaburagi, in the petition filed under Section 125 of Cr.P.C.
5.

sentences.text: Per contra, learned counsel appearing for the respondent contends that the distance is not much from Kalaburagi to Chittapur.
She also takes up a plea that the bus fare is free now by the Government of Karnataka and she would not have to spend much on finances to travel.

Therefore,
the petitioner can very well travel to Chittapur NC: 2026:KHC-K:769 HC-KAR to attend the Court.
Hence, she seeks dismissal of this petition.

6. Having heard learned counsel for both the parties, the Hon'ble Apex Court in catena of judgments has held that when the matrimonial proceedings are sought to be transferred from one place to another at the instance of the wife, generally it should be allowed at the behest of the wife, taking into consideration, of course, the distance, the hardship and the difficulty that would be faced by the wife and if any other co-ordinate petition is pending, where the husband has to travel to the place of the wife, then it would be prudent to transfer the petition to the place where the wife is residing,
where another petition is initiated by the wife against the husband.
In the present case, the petition under Section 125 of Cr.P.C., is initiated by the wife, which is pending before the Family Court at Kalaburagi.

Under the circumstances, the respondent/husband having already accepted notice, it would not be difficult for him to attend rather more NC: 2026:KHC-K:769 HC-KAR hardship and difficulty would be caused to the petitioner/wife than the respondent/husband.

Accordingly, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER (a) The Civil Petition is allowed.

(b) The matrimonial proceedings in M.C.No.33/2024, pending on the file of the Senior Civil Judge and JMFC Court, Chittapur is transferred to the Principal Judge,
Family Court, Kalaburagi to be tried along with Criminal Miscellaneous No.515/2023.
Ordered according.

Sd/-
